risk_if_not_implemented: Without Contingency Plan Testing For Alternate Storage & Processing Sites, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Contingency Plan Testing & Exercises
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct tests and/or exercises to evaluate the contingency plan's effectiveness and the organization's readiness to execute the plan.
compensating_control_1.justification: Contingency Plan Testing & Exercises (BCD-10) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Alternate Storage & Processing Sites (BCD-10.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Incident Response Capabilities Testing
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to formally test incident response capabilities through realistic exercises to determine the operational effectiveness of those capabilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Incident Response Capabilities Testing (IRO-09) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Alternate Storage & Processing Sites (BCD-10.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
